title: AIBE 21th Exam Result 2026 – Out
qualification: Law graduates enrolled / eligible as per BCI AIBE rules
applicationFee: As per AIBE XXI registration fee
selectionProcess: Offline/OMR based AIBE Exam → Result → Certificate of Practice (CoP) for qualified candidates
documentsRequired: User ID and Password for AIBE portal login
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.allindiabarexamination.com
2. Login with User ID and Password
3. View AIBE-XXI Result / Scorecard
4. Download result for CoP process
5. Apply for OMR rechecking if needed when window opens
shortDescription: AIBE 21 Result 2026 declared by Bar Council of India. Exam held on 7 June 2026; 1,15,805 candidates qualified (65.92% pass). Check at allindiabarexamination.com.
content:
The Bar Council of India (BCI) has declared the result of All India Bar Examination (AIBE-XXI) conducted on 07 June 2026.

Statistics

  • Qualified candidates: 1,15,805
  • Pass percentage: 65.92%
  • Result date: 18 July 2026

Candidates can check result by logging into the AIBE portal with User ID and Password. Qualified candidates become eligible for the Certificate of Practice. Rechecking window may open for candidates marked Fail or seeking re-evaluation.
